objectApiName.title: Object API Name
objectApiName.description: The API name of the Salesforce object to search, e.g. Account, Contact, Opportunity, or a custom object like Shipment__c. Use the exact API name, not the plural or display label.

recordName.title: Record Name
recordName.description: The value of the record's Name field to search for, e.g. Acme Corporation. Must be an exact match. Do not include the object type or extra words.
